source_checks.name: ordinary block boundary
source_checks.finding: arch_llama.c callback follows attention residual, MLP down residual and optional down bias; it precedes the next block and final output RMS normalization. Collector reads all 24 blocks without editing model weights.

source_checks.name: ChatML and positions
source_checks.finding: Collector reuses train_mlp.c mlp_role/mlp_encode and exact system/user strings, ending the assistant header at prompt_tokens-1. Fixed IDs [4913,3903,819] end at prompt_tokens+2. Runtime validates their raw tokenizer encoding.

source_checks.name: causal coverage
source_checks.finding: Every capture allocates a new KV cache. Header/prefix positions are copied once for every layer; duplicate, missing, nonfinite or out-of-shape observations fail. Chunk calls retain absolute positions.

source_checks.name: fresh z anchor
source_checks.finding: After ordinary captures and requested verification finish, a separate fresh-KV pass temporarily replaces only final wdown with zeros and disables final down bias. Existing helper restores original projection/bias before returning. Anchor is prefix post-final-attention/pre-final-MLP residual.

source_checks.name: runtime verification design
source_checks.finding: Rows 0 and 1 require all 48 vectors to agree against independent token stepping, future append and changed future. Each vector must satisfy absolute 1e-4 and relative-L2 1e-5. Raw errors and exact input IDs are retained; failed checks yield no accepted feature unit.

source_checks.name: ridge and normalization
source_checks.finding: C computes mean binary logistic loss plus lambda/2 times squared weights with free intercept. State lambda=.01, interpolation lambda=1e-8; concern is score>0. All means and RMS scales are computed from training rows only. Each family holdout excludes the entire pair/quartet.

source_checks.name: control and coverage
source_checks.finding: One fixed historical family-flip mask is applied consistently to train/test labels; pairs remain opposite and quartets remain grouped. Fifty views comprise 48 post-block states, one fresh z anchor, and seven-feature lexical/count baseline. Each view has 40 family-heldout fits plus two interpolation fits.

source_checks.name: validation and summary
source_checks.finding: Per-row validator checks prepared hashes/source strings, exact binary dimensions, source index, all trace fields, native token ranges/ChatML boundaries, anchor restoration and verification errors. Assembly invokes it for all 52 rows. Summary requires exact42fit/21normalization/2frame coverage per view and all2100fits converged.
